description: Defines ASN.1 structures, enums, and classes related to 3GPP NR RRC radio bearer configuration, including enumerations for ciphering algorithms, data split thresholds, timers, and complex sequence structures for radio bearer setup.

classes.name: ul_data_split_thres_opts
classes.description: Enumeration options for uplink data split thresholds.

classes.name: discard_timer_ext_r16_opts
classes.description: Enumeration options for extended discard timers in R16.

classes.name: ethernet_hdr_compress_r16_s
classes.description: Sequence structure for Ethernet header compression in R16.

classes.name: ul_data_compress_r17_c
classes.description: Choice structure for uplink data compression in R17.

classes.name: discard_timer_ext2_r17_opts
classes.description: Enumeration options for extended discard timers in R17.

classes.name: discard_timer_for_low_importance_r18_opts
classes.description: Enumeration options for discard timers for low importance in R18.

classes.name: integrity_prot_algorithm_opts
classes.description: Enumeration options for integrity protection algorithms.

classes.name: mrb_to_add_mod_r17_s
classes.description: Structure for MRB addition/modification in R17.

classes.name: mrb_to_add_mod_list_r17_l
classes.description: List of MRB addition/modification structures in R17.

classes.name: mrb_to_release_list_r17_l
classes.description: List of MRB release identifiers in R17.

classes.name: radio_bearer_cfg_s
classes.description: Main structure for radio bearer configuration.

methods.name: to_string
methods.description: Converts enum options to string representation.

methods.name: to_number
methods.description: Converts enum options to numeric value.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the value of choice structures.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the structure into bit stream.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Deserializes the structure from bit stream.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Serializes the structure into JSON format.
